title: When the Wolf Breaks Anew
author: Elodie Eastwick
blurb: August Underhill, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
